title: Tree of Thoughts: Beyond Linear Reasoning

beats.text: Models trapped in linear, token-by-token generation crumble when complex logic demands real strategic lookahead and planning.
beats.visual_focus: A singular, straight vector line snapping under pressure.

beats.text: Autoregressive models are like chess players forced to move every pawn instantly, without seeing the board's future state space.
beats.visual_focus: A blurry, dense probability cloud collapsing into a single, suboptimal token choice.

visual_blueprint.title: MONOLITHIC INFERENCE BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: State space restricted by greedy decoding

beats.text: Tree of Thoughts upgrades this by projecting partial solutions into a branching hierarchy, enabling dynamic exploration of multiple reasoning paths.
beats.visual_focus: A single point splitting into a cascading fractal tree of thought nodes.

beats.text: Each node runs self-evaluation on coherent text units, pruning dead-end branches before the model commits to a irreversible token trajectory.
